summary: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment to establish that constitutional rights apply only to natural persons, not artificial entities like corporations, and allows for the regulation of campaign finance to ensure equitable access to the political process, explicitly stating that spending money to influence elections is not protected as free speech.

scores.thoughts: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment that explicitly allows federal, state, and local governments to regulate campaign contributions and expenditures to ensure all citizens have access to the political process, regardless of economic status. It also states that spending money to influence elections should not be construed as speech under the First Amendment. This is a central component of the proposed amendment, directly aiming to reform election financing and access.

The bill is a constitutional amendment whose core purpose is to overturn Citizens United by declaring that corporations have no constitutional rights, explicitly authorizing federal/state/local governments to regulate or prohibit political contributions and expenditures (including disclosure requirements), and stating that money spent to influence elections is not protected speech. This is the central and sole substantive focus of the resolution.
